definitions: (Of a soluble chemical or mineral) drained away from soil, ash, or similar material by the action of percolating liquid, especially rainwater.
Subjected (soil, ash, or similar material) to the action of percolating liquid so as to drain away soluble chemicals or minerals.
Pervaded by or having lost a soluble chemical or mineral.
examples: The nutrients had leached out of the soil.
The rain leached the minerals from the rocks.
